did.abstract: The Larry Agran papers comprises the extant professional and political papers of Larry Agran, including correspondence, unpublished and published reports and documents, brochures and other ephemera, photographs, newspaper clippings, maps, calendars and diaries, and other materials relevant to Agran's early life, role in the city of Irvine government, presidential candidacy, and other civic and public work. Larry Agran is a former mayor and city councilman of the city of Irvine, California and former Democratic candidate for the 1992 US presidency.

accessrestrict.head: Access
accessrestrict.p: This collection is open for research. Access to original audio tapes and video recordings is restricted; contact the Department of Special Collections and Archives at spcoll@uci.edu for more information.

bioghist.head: Historical Background
bioghist.p: Larry Agran is a former mayor and city councilman of the city of Irvine, California and former Democratic candidate for the 1992 US presidency.

Agran served on the Irvine City Council between 1978 and 1990, 1998 and 2014, and was elected to the City Council again in 2020. He was also mayor of Irvine from 1982 to 1984, 1986 to 1990, and 2000 to 2004.

Agran was also the chair of the board of directors of the Orange County Great Park from 2004 to 2010. The board was charged with planning, constructing, and operating a new park at the former Marine Corps Air Base El Toro in Irvine.
